correctness.rationale: For general smooth complex plane curves d≥4, the classical Plücker invariants are D=d(d−1), F=3d(d−2), B=d(d−2)(d−3)(d+3)/2. Division by d and Euclid give gcd(D/d,F/d)=gcd(d−1,3). When d≡1 mod3, B/d is nonzero mod3, so gcd(D,F,B)=d. Pair gcds arise from d²−9≡−8 (mod d−1), a trivial parity split and factoring out d−2. Independently checked all three claimed pairwise gcd expressions and triple gcd for every integer 4≤d≤20000 using Python integer arithmetic; this checks, but does not replace, the elementary for-all-d proof.
